correspondences.notes: Code has no BIDS raw counterpart.

brainlife.desc: Directory with a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb/.py) and related content. No App reads or writes it.
brainlife.name: jupyter/notebook

original.desc: A datatype to store jupyter notebook content

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Storing analysis notebooks alongside a project's data.

**Not for:** Input to Apps; none use it.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/jupyter.notebook.json

identifying_risks: Saved cell outputs may embed participant data, paths or IDs.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 2: content varies; notebooks with outputs can carry participant-level data, so Tier 2 by default.
sharing_cautions: Clear outputs and check for credentials and paths before sharing.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 if it holds code only, with no data or outputs.

intended_use: Storing analysis notebooks alongside a project's data.
not_suitable_for: Input to Apps; none use it.
